name: SRIKANTH YADUGANI
title: ==SENIOR LEAD QA ENGINEER (FX)==  |  FINANCIAL SERVICES QA

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: QA lead with 15+ years of experience delivering end-to-end testing and automation for financial services and retirement platforms. Experienced with Java, Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber/BDD, SQL, API testing, Maven and release coordination across functional, integration and regression testing. Brings production issue triage, test evidence, mentoring and CI-driven regression delivery; contributed to migration of existing automation capabilities using Playwright libraries and TypeScript.

roles.title: Lead QA Software Engineer | progression from Trainee and Software Tester
roles.meta: February 2011 - September 2026 | Financial Services and Retirement
bullets: Led and contributed to end-to-end QA, translating client and project requirements into scenarios, test cases, estimates and execution plans.
Automated sprint stories using Selenium WebDriver, Java and Cucumber/BDD, then incorporated completed scripts into regression.
Executed functional, integration and regression testing; triaged defects, retested fixes and published X-Ray execution results.
Performed API testing with Postman and validated database, report, XML and pipe-delimited data using SQL tools.
Scheduled weekly regression through GitLab and GitHub Pipelines, configured Jenkins jobs and coordinated release builds.
Enhanced automation utilities for plan-health reports, PDF comparison, CCD Scrubber and CCD Splitter.
Coordinated QA and Production deployments after Veracode scans and report publication; mentored QA colleagues and communicated readiness.

roles.title: Lead QA Engineer / Senior Quality Analyst
bullets: Worked on a financial and retirement communications platform covering document composition, data integration and print, email and online delivery.
Client organizations included Nationwide, MissionSquare, T. Rowe Price, Equitable, LPL, American Funds, DFA and Security Benefit.

roles.title: Quality Analyst
bullets: Tested retirement recordkeeping products and executed Selenium/QTP regression across participant and sponsor applications.
